# Optees

Optees is an open-source desktop operations-research workbench and local solver
platform. People can formulate and inspect problems visually; scripts and AI
agents can discover, validate, execute, and verify versioned solver contracts
through CLI, authenticated loopback REST, or private MCP stdio.

## Released Capabilities

- LP with HiGHS, JSON import/export, multiple-optima range analysis, and
  feasible-region views for low-dimensional problems.
- MILP with continuous, integer, and binary variables, time limits, and MIP
  gap controls.
- Knapsack 0/1, Bounded, Unbounded, Fractional, and Multi-dimensional.
- Orthogonal single-container 3D Packing with allowed rotations, optional
  capacities, selection policies, and simple gravity.
- Continuous NLP using BFGS, Nelder-Mead, or L-BFGS-B. Results are local
  numerical candidates, not global-optimality certificates.
- Dijkstra shortest paths for directed or undirected graphs with finite,
  non-negative weights.
- Educational Linear Regression and Binary Logistic Classification with
  reproducible held-out evaluation.
- A fully local, deterministic rule-based modeling assistant for LP, MILP,
  Knapsack, NLP, graph, and educational ML recommendations and validated JSON
  drafts where supported. This assistant is not an LLM.

## Local Agent Service

- 12 versioned capability descriptors with input and result JSON schemas.
- Exact payload validation before solver execution.
- Asynchronous local jobs with separate lifecycle, mathematical, termination,
  and solution-validation statuses.
- Independent result checks currently registered for LP and MILP.
- REST binds only to 127.0.0.1 and requires a per-session bearer token.
- MCP uses a private stdio subprocess and does not open a network port.
- Hosted agents cannot access a user's localhost without an explicit bridge.

Agent setup: https://github.com/Pablo-gitub/optees/blob/main/docs/AGENTS_SERVICE_CONFIG.md
